objective: Implement the opt-in Stage 3 six-dimension Codex-session candidate research path: independent per-dimension usage limits across nodes, bounded concurrency, persistent lane sessions, evidence validation, durable recovery and archive-after-persistence. Preserve canonical Stage 3 and all other stages. Use the shared Coding Agent Platform with LangGraph as sole Coding orchestrator; add no product framework dependency. This candidate does not inherit the old paired-ablation shared-dollar budget contract. No live provider smoke without separate explicit authorization.
acceptance_checks: PRD AC-01..AC-14 and all related API/System Design invariants are implemented; runtime changes show observed TDD RED/GREEN, not post-hoc claims.

Six dimension lanes each have immutable independent task/turn/round/time/source/token limits; at most six owned persistent sessions, concurrency <= configured maximum, one turn per lane; every research/assess attempt is accounted.
Unknown thread creation, turn dispatch or termination does not trigger blind retry, replacement sessions, budget resets or unsafe archive; receipts, fencing and usage high-watermarks survive restart.
Model evidence is independently fetched and validated; only current v1.4 pure validation and deterministic finalization are reused; no unbudgeted model scorer, critic or relief calls.
Candidate artifacts use a separate database and explicit subscription usage with actual_cost_usd=null; canonical domain/RPC databases, scoring governance and legacy behavior remain unchanged.
Terminal lane artifacts persist before confirmed archive and unsubscribe; cleanup retries never rerun research, delete or compact sessions, or affect unrelated threads.

Offline protocol/feature tests cover AC-01..AC-13 including state recovery, invalid inputs, budget boundaries, source safety and cleanup; existing Stage 3/4/composition/orchestrator/repository/RPC regressions pass.

New feature tests must be selectable by pytest -k stage3_codex_sessions; selection must collect at least one test and fail closed if empty. Live Codex smoke remains separately authorized, and offline success makes no production, UI or cost-saving claim.

Code P0/P1 return through platform Developer loop; Document P0/P1 stop for document revision and new human-approved Bundle; report exact bundle SHA, candidate source snapshot SHA and open P2 at Human Final Confirmation; never self-authorize GO.
